source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify NVMe Configuration defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without hiding controllers or namespaces, changing boot storage, altering VMD/RAID or security semantics, degrading PCIe health or risking data integrity.
original_method: Manually load BIOS defaults, compare named NVMe fields with SPEC, apply a bounded field/controller matrix, save and use the documented reset, verify persistence plus controller, namespace, boot, filesystem and health state read-only.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept NVMe firmware fields, including default restore and persistence. Automated storage inventories are read-only supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Board/BIOS/BMC, CPU/root-complex and NVMe backplane/topology identity
Named fields mapped to controllers, namespaces, boot roles and VMD/RAID/security behavior
SPEC defaults and approved non-default values
Persistent device/namespace identifiers, mount/filesystem/workload state and backup confirmation
Known-good boot path, independent console/OOB and storage recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or change namespace, sanitize/format, security, VMD/RAID or boot-storage semantics without separate explicit approval.
No write, format, secure erase, namespace management or destructive benchmark is authorized by this review.
Identify boot, OS, mounted, protected and in-use devices by persistent identity; do not rely on /dev names or BDF alone.
Verify backups and independent recovery before any field that can hide or remap storage.
Stop on missing/remapped namespace, boot failure, filesystem/mount anomaly, media/PCIe health regression or management loss.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only controller/namespace identity, topology/link, firmware, health, boot entries, block-device/mount/filesystem metadata, kernel logs and BMC status.
Compare approved expected deltas without opening namespaces for write or changing drivers/modes.
Do not drive BIOS, issue admin/destructive NVMe commands, change VMD/RAID or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve exact fields, devices, expected mapping, reset type, backup and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases.
Interpret storage, boot and health evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS namespace, driver, RAID or format operations are not equivalent and are unsafe substitutions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded read-only NVMe controller/namespace, PCIe, boot, mount and health collection only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each BIOS field to exact controller and namespace persistent IDs plus boot/VMD/RAID/security effects; diff topology, link, namespace, boot, mount and health evidence across default, persistence and final states without writes.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact NVMe topology, firmware, VMD/RAID mode and installed storage population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, NVMe/PCIe tool, OS/kernel, driver and controller firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform NVMe Configuration documentation and vendor controller/device guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with device-specific, non-destructive expected deltas and explicit backup/recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves default/persistence and adds namespace, boot, topology and health integrity coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/device map, values, identities, backup, reset and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Enumeration names and PCI addresses can change; persistent controller and namespace identities are required.

project_override_considerations: A project may select named controllers, namespaces and safe fields. Results must state excluded devices, VMD/RAID/security and boot scenarios and cannot claim full NVMe coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform/topology identity, field/device/default matrix, approvals, backup and recovery
Baseline persistent controller/namespace IDs, link, boot, mount/filesystem and health evidence
Load Default captures plus SPEC and storage-state comparison
Non-default captures, persistence and exact expected storage/topology deltas
Approved final state, anomaly logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Exact devices and safe fields are project readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The NVMe configuration lifecycle is clear. Missing device mapping, backup or recovery must gate execution but does not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds storage identity, write-protection and recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its NVMe/PCIe/boot/filesystem evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware acceptance from read-only storage evidence and explicitly forbids unapproved write or namespace operations.

review_improvement: Prevents a persisted value from being accepted when a namespace is remapped, boot storage disappears, VMD/RAID semantics change or data integrity is placed at risk.
independent_technical_reasoning: Core acceptance is interactive firmware configuration and visual verification. Read-only NVMe evidence can validate consequences but cannot complete the manual firmware work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat NVMe field changes, resets or recovery after namespace, boot, filesystem, link or health anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
